title: Degree: warm
instructions: Choose the word that best preserves the exact meaning, degree and attitude supported by the sentence.

parts.prompt: After thirty minutes in the shade, the metal railing felt ___—only slightly above body temperature and comfortable to touch.

choice_rationales.A: Boiling describes an extreme temperature associated with a liquid reaching its boiling point and contradicts comfortable contact.
choice_rationales.B: Scorching suggests heat intense enough to burn, which contradicts comfortable contact.
choice_rationales.C: Warm expresses noticeable but moderate heat and matches the evidence that touching the railing remained comfortable.
choice_rationales.D: Hot is stronger than warm and normally suggests discomfort or risk in this touching context.

parts.hint: Place the four options on a heat scale, then use ‘comfortable to touch’ as the upper limit.
parts.correct_explanation: The railing has moderate heat rather than painful or extreme heat, so ‘warm’ matches the supported degree.
